description: This file implements a custom HTTP RoundTripper with disk-based caching, including cache integrity verification using SHA256 hashes, for use within Kubernetes client-go discovery caching.

classes.name: cacheRoundTripper
classes.description: Custom implementation of http.RoundTripper that adds caching behavior and request cancellation.

classes.name: sumDiskCache
classes.description: Cache backend that uses SHA256 hashes to verify cache integrity on disk.

methods.name: newCacheRoundTripper
methods.description: Creates a new cache-enabled RoundTripper with specified cache directory and underlying transport.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Performs an HTTP round trip, delegating to the underlying cached transport.

methods.name: CancelRequest
methods.description: Attempts to cancel an ongoing request if supported by the underlying transport.

methods.name: WrappedRoundTripper
methods.description: Returns the underlying RoundTripper used by the cacheRoundTripper.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response from disk, verifying SHA256 checksum for integrity.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores a response in the cache on disk, prefixing with SHA256 hash for integrity.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from disk.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Generates a SHA256-based filename-safe key from the original cache key.
